releasePlan.notes: Flag 'enable-player-login' was created (rework iteration 2) in LaunchDarkly project 'default': string multivariate, variations control + v1, dark, client-side SDK availability on. The code defaults to 'control'. Attribution fixes in rework 2: (1) the LD context is now {kind:'user', anonymous:true} with NO hard-coded key. JS SDK v3 generates and caches a key for each visitor, so percentage and guarded rollouts bucket each visitor separately. The old shared key 'anonymous-player' is gone. (2) Login no longer switches the context key. The callsign is attached as the 'name' attribute through identify({...getContext(), name}), which keeps the anonymous key the flag was evaluated for. If getContext() can't provide a key, identify() is skipped. So login-completed, game-started, time-to-start and error events all land on the bucketed context in both arms. Metrics: enable-player-login-error-rate (killswitch, event enable-player-login-error); enable-player-login-game-started (pause, event enable-player-login-game-started); enable-player-login-latency (monitoring, event key MUST be enable-player-login-time-to-start; v1 is slower by design because players type a callsign); enable-player-login-login-completed (monitoring, v1 only). Mapping of the latency metric to event 'enable-player-login-time-to-start' should be confirmed by the metrics step. Note: changing the context key also affects the existing 'invaders-shooter-sprite' flag, which is now bucketed per visitor instead of one shared key.
